outcome: correctness of the decision for caesarean section
agreement between reviewers on indications for caesarean section
cohort: The study participants were women aged 15-44 years (mean 27.01 years) who gave birth at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital during the study week.
finding: The study found few absolute disagreements regarding the cited indications for caesarean sections, with high agreement for common indications like fetal distress and dystocia, which were also the most frequent.
mod_finding: The study evaluated the correctness and agreement of indications for caesarean sections, a specific mode of birth, finding generally high agreement among reviewers.
cross-section timing: The week of 23 June to 29 June 2015
